sources.title: Tiny Aya - Cohere - LLM Database
sources.snippet: Tiny Aya is Cohere Labs' 3.35B multilingual model family designed to make local language generation practical across 70 languages. The family includes a base checkpoint, a globally balanced instruction model, and Earth, Fire, and Water regional variants. sources.title: Tiny Aya - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: The release includes Tiny Aya Base, a 3.35B-parameter pretrained model spanning 70 languages; Tiny Aya Global, an instruction-tuned model optimized for consistent multilingual performance; and three region-specialized variants that reinforce linguistic clusters while preserving a shared multilingual foundation.
